note: Generated by Tools/Art/xcassets-art.js from an asset catalog; do not edit. rect is [x, y, width, height] in page pixels, top left origin; size is [width, height] in points; caps is [top, left, bottom, right] in points; an asset taken at another scale than the index's carries its own. A page with format astc is a KTX file of ASTC blocks of block [width, height] and its levels mip levels, premultiplied, bottom row first; quality is how its level 0 decodes against the art (PSNR in dB, worst channel error, channel values off by more than 24 in 10,000).
